KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "mche" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kufanana kwa umbo na yasiwe na maana sawa. Mche ni mmea mchanga wa kupanda, si mchele.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks a word from the same sentence, not the word asked.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "kuchemsha" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child picks the meaning of a nearby action.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: The meaning of the word next to it as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Put each meaning in place of the word. Which one fits?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Jaribu kila maana mahali pa neno hilo. Maana sahihi ndiyo inayofaa sentensi nzima.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.error: Picks the opposite of the word.

example.question: Katika kifungu, neno "madonge" lina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.cause: The child knows what the word is about but not which way it points.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.reveals: The opposite meaning as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.help: Read the sentence again: does it say the thing is there or not?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.feedback: Maana ya neno hutegemea sentensi lilimotumika. Madonge ni vipande vilivyoshikana, si unga laini.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Names the wrong person from the story.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child goes by the name that comes first in the passage.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A question about who, with other people in the story.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the sentence that names the person who did it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Kifungu kinasema nani alifanya kitendo hicho. Soma sentensi hiyo tena.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives an answer from what the child knows, not from the passage.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child answers from life and does not look in the text.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A likely answer that the story does not give.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Point to the sentence in the passage that says it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu la swali la ufahamu liko kwenye kifungu. Tafuta sentensi inayolisema.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Picks another detail from the story.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child picks a detail from the right place but not the one asked.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Read the question word again: who, when, where, what?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Maneno ya swali (nani, lini, wapi, nini) yanaonyesha jibu la aina gani. Soma kifungu tena.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives a detail for the main message.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child takes the most vivid detail.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: A detail and a message as options.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: What did the story want us to learn?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Puts the events in the wrong order.

example.question: Matukio manne yamechanganywa. Yalitokea kwa mpangilio gani?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child goes by the order in the question and not in the story.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: Four events shown out of order.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Find the first event, then the next.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hadithi inasimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Maneno kama "kisha" na "baadaye" husaidia.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Calls a text that describes a person or thing a masimulizi.

example.question: Ni insha ya aina gani? "Bibi yangu ni mpole. Ana nywele nyeupe na anapenda kusimulia hadithi."

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child sees that it is about a person and thinks of a story.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Does the text tell what happened in order, or what the person is like?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Wasifu humwelezea mtu au kitu: sura, tabia na maisha. Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Calls a text that tells what happened a wasifu.

example.question: Ni insha ya aina gani? "Jumamosi, Achieng alienda sokoni. Mvua ilianza kunyesha, akakimbilia dukani."

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child sees a person and thinks it describes her.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Is something happening, one thing after another?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia mambo yaliyotokea kwa mpangilio. Wasifu huelezea jinsi mtu alivyo.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Calls a text that explains how to do something a masimulizi.

example.question: Ni insha ya aina gani? "Ili kupika wali, osha mchele kwanza. Kisha chemsha maji."

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child sees steps and reads them as events.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.reveals: Instructions that sound like a story.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Is it telling what happened, or how to do it?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu hatua kwa hatua.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.error: Mixes the parts of an insha (utangulizi, kiini, hitimisho).

example.question: Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.cause: The child knows the three names but not their order.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.reveals: The three parts asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Which part comes first, which in the middle, which last?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi mwanzoni, kiini katikati na hitimisho mwishoni.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.error: Picks a verb (a word for an action) for a noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.cause: The child sees a word that goes with the sentence and does not ask what kind of word it is.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.reveals: A gap that needs a thing, with a verb among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.help: Ask: is it the name of something, or something being done?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.feedback: Nomino ni jina la mtu, mnyama, mahali au kitu. "Anapika" ni kitenzi, kinaonyesha kitendo.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.error: Picks an adjective (a word that describes) for a noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.cause: The child picks the word that tells about the thing, not the thing.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.help: Can you hold it, see it or name it? Then it may be a noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.feedback: Nomino ni jina la kitu chenyewe. "Kubwa" ni kivumishi, kinaeleza kitu kikoje.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.error: Picks a word of time or manner (haraka, jana, sana) for a noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.cause: The child picks a short word that fits the sentence.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.reveals: A noun among words of time and manner.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.feedback: "Haraka" na "jana" ni vielezi: vinaonyesha jinsi au wakati. Nomino hutaja mtu, mnyama, mahali au kitu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.M4_NOM_A.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Picks a noun for a verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: The child takes the word nearest the gap that names a thing.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: A gap that needs an action, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: Kitenzi kinaonyesha kitendo: anacheza. "Uwanja" ni nomino, ni jina la mahali.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Picks an adjective for a verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: The child picks a word that goes with chakula.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: A gap that needs an action, with a describing word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.help: Can you do the word? Cooking can be done; "kitamu" cannot.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: Kitenzi kinaonyesha kitendo. "Kitamu" ni kivumishi, kinaeleza chakula kikoje.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.error: Picks a word of time or manner (sasa, mapema) for a verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.cause: The child picks a small word that seems to fit.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.reveals: A gap that needs an action, with a time or manner word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.feedback: "Mapema" ni kielezi cha wakati. Kitenzi ni neno la kitendo, kama "wanapanda".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.M4_VER.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Picks a noun for an adjective.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: The child picks a word for a person.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: A gap that needs a describing word, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Ask: does the word tell what kind of child?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Kivumishi kinaeleza nomino ikoje, kama "mdogo". "Mwalimu" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Picks a verb for an adjective.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: The child fills the gap with any word that fits the meaning.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: A gap that needs a describing word, with a verb among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Does the word tell how the house is, or what it does?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Kivumishi kinaeleza nomino ikoje: nyumba nzuri. "Inaonekana" ni kitenzi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.error: Uses an adjective that does not agree with its noun (watoto mdogo, kiti mkubwa).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.cause: The child keeps the form of the adjective for one thing.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.reveals: Plural and singular nouns in turn, with the same adjective.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.help: Count: one or many? The adjective changes with the noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.feedback: Kivumishi hubadilika kulingana na nomino: mtoto mdogo, watoto wadogo; kiti kikubwa, viti vikubwa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.M4.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Gives the greeting back as the reply (Hujambo for Sijambo).
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child repeats the word he heard.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: A greeting and its reply as options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Who is asking, and who answers?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Hujambo hujibiwa kwa "Sijambo". Shikamoo hujibiwa kwa "Marahaba".
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting of the wrong time of day (habari za asubuhi at night).

example.question: Kabla ya kulala usiku unamwambia mama, "___."

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child knows the greeting but not when it is used.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: A morning greeting for an evening situation.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: What time of day is it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: "Habari za asubuhi" ni ya asubuhi. "Usiku mwema" husemwa usiku kabla ya kulala.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets an elder with the greeting for a friend (hujambo for shikamoo).
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child uses one greeting for everyone.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: An elder and a friend as the people greeted.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Is the person older than you?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mdogo humsalimia mkubwa kwa "Shikamoo", na mkubwa hujibu "Marahaba". "Hujambo" ni ya rika moja.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Looks at the first letter only (words that begin alike).

example.question: Kati ya "samaki", "sahani" na "sufuria", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child stops when the first letters are the same.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: When the first letters match, look at the second.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Maneno yakianza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Kati ya "ua", "ardhi" na "wali", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child orders by how short or long the word is.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: A short word that begins with a late letter.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Go by the letters of the alphabet, not by how long the word is.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Goes from z back to a.

example.question: Kati ya "baba", "mto" na "zeze", neno linalokuja kwanza ni ___.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child reads the alphabet from the end.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: First and last words asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na a na kuishia na z. Neno lenye herufi ya mwanzo karibu na a hutangulia.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Does not know what a dictionary is for (takes it for a storybook or a book of pictures).
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child has seen a dictionary but not used it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: The use of a dictionary asked directly.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: What do you look for when you meet a word you do not know?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi ni kitabu chenye maneno na maana zake, yaliyopangwa kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Repeats the noun instead of using a pronoun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child does not see that a pronoun stands in place of the name.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A second sentence that needs a pronoun, with the name among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Ask: which word saves us saying the name again?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: Kiwakilishi husimama mahali pa nomino ili tusirudie jina: "Yeye" badala ya "Wanjiru".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Uses a pronoun for one where there are many, or for many where there is one (yeye for wao).

example.question: Juma na Otieno ni marafiki. ___ wanacheza pamoja.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child does not count the people.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A pair of people with a one-person pronoun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Count the people. One is "yeye", many are "wao".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: "Yeye" ni mtu mmoja. "Wao" ni watu wengi. Juma na Otieno ni wawili, kwa hiyo ni "wao".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Swaps the person (mimi, wewe, yeye, sisi, nyinyi, wao).

example.question: Mimi na wewe ni marafiki. ___ tunasoma pamoja.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child knows the pronouns but not who is speaking.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A sentence about the speaker and the listener.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Does it include me, the speaker?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: "Sisi" ni mimi na wengine. "Wao" ni watu wengine, bila mimi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.error: Swaps the near and the far one (huyu for yule, hawa for wale).

example.question: Angalia, ___ ni mwalimu wetu, ameketi karibu nami.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.cause: The child does not take the distance into account.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.reveals: A person who is close and a person who is far, with both words as options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.help: Is the person near you or far from you?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.feedback: "Huyu" na "hawa" hutumika kwa walio karibu. "Yule" na "wale" hutumika kwa walio mbali.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Uses an adjective for an adverb (anaimba nzuri for anaimba vizuri).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child uses the describing word of a noun for the way something is done.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: A gap that tells how something is done, with the adjective among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Does it tell how they sing, or what kind of thing it is?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: Kielezi kinaonyesha jinsi kitendo kinavyofanyika: wanaimba vizuri. "Nzuri" ni kivumishi cha nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Picks a noun for an adverb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child picks a word of the place and not the way.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: A gap that tells how something is done, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Does the word tell how he ran?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: "Haraka" ni kielezi cha jinsi. "Barabara" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.error: Mixes the three kinds of adverb (time, place, manner).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.cause: The child knows the word is an adverb but not what it tells.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.reveals: Adverbs of time, place and manner asked in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.help: Ask: does it tell when, where or how?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.feedback: Vielezi vya wakati (jana, kesho), mahali (hapa, mbali) na jinsi (polepole, haraka) vinajibu "lini", "wapi" na "vipi".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.M4_ADV.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: A riddle hides an answer. Can you guess it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Can you give an answer to it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili kina jibu la kutegua.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Does not know the words used when riddling (Kitendawili! Tega!).
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child has heard a riddle told but not the fixed words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.reveals: The opening and the giving-up words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: What does the guesser say to say he is ready?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Mtegaji husema "Kitendawili!" na mtegua hujibu "Tega!". Akishindwa husema "Nipe mji."
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks that reading fast is reading well.

example.question: Ni nini kinachoonyesha kusoma kwa ufasaha?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child hears that good readers are quick.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Can the listener follow every word?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Kasi ifaayo si haraka sana wala polepole sana: msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks that reading loud is reading well.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child takes loud for clear.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Is a shout the same as a clear voice?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo inasikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Ignores the koma and the kikomo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child reads the words and skips the marks.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A mark that asks for a rest.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: What does the mark tell the reader to do?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinaonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: koma kidogo, kikomo muda mrefu zaidi.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Mixes the parts of a computer (kibodi, kipanya, skrini).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child knows the names but not what each is.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: Parts asked by what they are used for.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: What do you hold, press or look at?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kibodi ina vitufe vya herufi na nambari. Kipanya husogeza kielekezi. Skrini huonyesha. Kichapishi huchapisha.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Gives the use of another part.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child has the right word for the wrong job.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: The use of the part asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: What do you do with this part?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kila sehemu ya tarakilishi ina kazi yake: skrini huonyesha, kichapishi huchapisha kwenye karatasi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child does not see the first letter.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: The same sentence with a small and a capital letter.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.help: What do we write first in a sentence?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya pekee pia: Wanjiru, Nairobi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Ends a question with a kikomo (.) instead of a kiulizi (?).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child ends every sentence with a full stop.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: The same question with different marks.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Sentensi ya swali huisha kwa kiulizi (?). Sentensi ya kawaida huisha kwa kikomo (.).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Leaves out the koma in a list, or puts it in the wrong place.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child does not pause the sentence where the list items end.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: A list with and without koma.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.help: Where would you rest your voice?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Koma hutenganisha vitu katika orodha: maembe, machungwa na ndizi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Uses the wrong mark for a feeling (alama ya hisi !) or for a question.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child does not tell a feeling from a question.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.help: Is it asking, or showing a feeling?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia kama furaha au mshangao: Hongera! Kiulizi (?) huuliza.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.error: Leaves out the mark at the end of the sentence.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.cause: The child stops writing at the last word.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.reveals: The same sentence with and without its closing mark.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.feedback: Kila sentensi huisha kwa alama: kikomo (.), kiulizi (?) au alama ya hisi (!).
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.error: Picks a joining word of another meaning (kwa sababu for lakini, ili for au).

example.question: Alitaka kuogelea, ___ ziwa lilikuwa na mawimbi makali.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.cause: The child picks a joining word without asking how the two parts are related.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.reveals: Two parts that are in contrast, with the reason word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.help: Do the two parts agree, or does the second go against the first?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.feedback: Kila kiunganishi kina kazi: "lakini" kinaonyesha kinyume, "kwa sababu" kinatoa sababu, "ili" kinaonyesha kusudi, "na" kinaongeza.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.error: Picks a noun or a verb for a joining word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.cause: The child chooses a word that is already in the sentence.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.reveals: A gap between two names, with a noun among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.help: Which word joins the two names?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.feedback: Kiunganishi huunganisha maneno au sentensi, kama "na", "lakini" na "kwa sababu". Si nomino wala kitenzi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Picks a noun, a verb or an adjective as the relating word.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi katika sentensi: "Kitabu kiko juu ya meza."

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: The child picks the word that is easiest to see.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: A sentence with a place word, with the nouns as options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Which words tell where the book is in relation to the table?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: Kihusishi hueleza uhusiano wa nomino na neno lingine, kama "juu ya", "chini ya" na "ndani ya". "Meza" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Uses the wrong -a of agreement for the noun (kitabu wa mwalimu, nyumba cha bibi).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: The child keeps one form for every noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: Nouns of different classes before the same word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Which class is the noun in? Kitabu is KI-VI, so cha.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: Kihusishi cha "a" hubadilika kulingana na ngeli: kitabu cha, vitabu vya, mlango wa, milango ya, jina la, majina ya, nyumba ya.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.error: Swaps place words that mean the opposite (juu ya for chini ya, ndani ya for nje ya).

example.question: Samaki wanaishi ___ ya maji, si nje yake.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.cause: The child knows the words but not which way each points.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.reveals: A sentence that says where, with the opposite word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.help: Read the clue in the sentence: inside or outside?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.feedback: "Ndani ya" na "nje ya" ni vinyume. "Juu ya" na "chini ya" ni vinyume pia.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.error: Picks an exclamation of another feeling (hongera for pole).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.cause: The child knows the words but does not ask what the feeling is.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.reveals: A sad situation, with a happy word among the options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.help: What does the other person feel? What would you say?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.feedback: Kihisishi huonyesha hisia: "Pole!" kwa huzuni, "Hongera!" kwa mafanikio, "Samahani!" ukikosea, "Karibu!" kwa mgeni.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.error: Picks a noun or a verb for an exclamation.

example.question: Hongera! Juma ameshinda mbio za shule. Ni kihisishi kipi?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.cause: The child does not know the exclamation has the mark ! and shows a feeling.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.reveals: A sentence that begins with an exclamation, with the other words as options.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.help: Which word shows a feeling and carries the mark !?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.feedback: Kihisishi kinaonyesha hisia na huandikwa pamoja na alama ya hisi (!). "Juma" ni nomino.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.M4.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..error: Asks with a command and no polite word (Nipe maji!).
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..cause: The child does not hear the tone of the order.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..reveals: A request and a command side by side.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..help: Which one would you like to be asked?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..feedback: Tunapoomba kitu tunatumia "tafadhali" na "naomba", si amri.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..error: Swaps the polite words (asante for samahani).

example.question: Umemgonga mwenzako kwa bahati mbaya. Utasema "___."

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..cause: The child knows the words but not what each is for.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..reveals: A situation with a thank-you, an apology and a request among the options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..help: What did you do, and what would you want to say?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..feedback: "Samahani" husemwa ukikosea. "Asante" husemwa ukipewa kitu. "Pole" husemwa kwa aliyeumia.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..error: Takes a plain sentence for a polite one.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina neno la upole?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..cause: The child does not look for the polite word.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..reveals: Sentences with and without a polite word.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..help: Which sentence has a word like tafadhali, samahani or asante?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..feedback: Maneno ya upole ni kama tafadhali, samahani, asante, pole na naomba.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.error: Gives out a password or a private detail.

example.question: Rafiki anakuomba nenosiri la simu yako. Ufanye nini?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.cause: The child thinks that sharing with a friend is harmless.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.reveals: A friend or a stranger who asks.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.feedback: Nenosiri na maelezo kama anwani ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.error: Opens an unknown link or file.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.reveals: A message with a link from a stranger.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.help: Can you tell where the link leads?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.feedback: Kiungo au faili usiyoijua inaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuifungua.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.error: Uses any site, or one that asks for private details.

example.question: Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma mtandaoni. Utumie tovuti ipi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.cause: The child takes the first result.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.reveals: A site that asks for a phone number or money.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.help: Who said the site is safe?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.feedback: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi. Tovuti inayoomba nambari ya simu au pesa si salama.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.error: Puts the parts of a letter in the wrong order.

example.question: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa anwani ya mwandishi, kisha tarehe, kisha ___.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.cause: The child knows the parts but not their order.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.reveals: The parts of a letter asked in turn.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.help: What comes after the date, and what before the end?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki ina anwani ya mwandishi, tarehe, salamu, mwili, hitimisho na jina.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.error: Writes the wrong greeting or closing for a friend (Wako mtiifu for Rafiki yako).

example.question: Hitimisho la barua ya kirafiki ni "___ ".

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.cause: The child mixes a friendly letter with an official one.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.reveals: A friendly closing and an official one.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.help: Who is the letter to: a friend or an officer?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa "Mpendwa..." na kuisha kwa "Rafiki yako". "Wako mtiifu" ni ya barua rasmi.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.error: Writes the address of the writer in the wrong place.

example.question: Anwani ya mwandishi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.cause: The child writes it where the greeting goes.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.help: Which corner is the address of the writer?
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.feedback: Anwani ya mwandishi huandikwa upande wa kulia juu, kisha tarehe chini yake.
KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.error: Uses wa- for one person or a- for many people.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.cause: The child does not count, or goes by the word before.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.feedback: Nomino za ngeli ya A-WA hutumia a- kwa umoja na wa- kwa wingi: mtoto anaimba, watoto wanaimba.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.error: Gives animals the prefix of things (ndege inaruka) instead of A-WA (ndege wanaruka).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.cause: The child thinks only people are in A-WA.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.help: Is it alive and moving? People and animals take a- and wa-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.feedback: Watu na wanyama wote wako katika ngeli ya A-WA: paka anaruka, ndege wanaruka.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.error: Puts a thing into A-WA (kitabu anasomwa).

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya A-WA?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.cause: The child picks a noun that begins with m- or a vowel and does not ask if it is a person or an animal.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.help: Is it a person or an animal?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.feedback: Ngeli ya A-WA ni ya watu na wanyama. Kitabu ni kitu, kiko katika ngeli ya KI-VI.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.error: Makes a wrong plural noun for a person (vitoto, mitoto for watoto).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.cause: The child puts on a prefix from another class.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.reveals: Singular and plural nouns of people.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.help: Which prefix do people take for many?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.feedback: Wingi wa mtoto ni watoto, wa mwalimu ni walimu: m- hubadilika kuwa wa-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.error: Takes the methali word for word.

example.question: Methali "Samaki mkunje angali mbichi" ina maana gani?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.cause: The child reads the words and not the meaning.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.reveals: A literal meaning as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.help: What lesson is the saying giving us?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.feedback: Methali hutumia maneno ya picha ili kutoa funzo. Maana yake ni funzo, si maneno yenyewe.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.error: Gives the meaning of another methali.

example.question: Methali "Mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo" ina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: Tabia ya mtoto hutokana na malezi yake

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.cause: The child knows the topic but mixes the sayings.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.reveals: Meanings of two methali on the same topic.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.help: Which part of the saying does the meaning explain?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Soma maneno yake kwa makini kabla ya kuchagua maana.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.error: Takes an ordinary sentence or another saying for a methali.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.cause: The child does not tell a methali from a plain sentence.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.help: Does it give a lesson in few words?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.feedback: Methali ni maneno machache yanayotoa funzo la maisha.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.error: Changes a word of the methali, or joins the beginning of one to the end of another.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.cause: The child remembers the sense but not the exact words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.reveals: A gap in a methali with plausible words.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.help: Say the methali from the beginning.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.feedback: Methali husemwa kwa maneno yale yale: "Samaki mkunje angali mbichi". Tukibadilisha neno, haitambuliki.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M4_MET.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Swaps ubeti (a group of lines) and mshororo (one line).
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child knows both words but not which is which.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: One line, or a group of lines?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Mshororo ni mstari mmoja wa shairi. Ubeti ni kundi la mishororo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Counts the lines of the whole poem for the lines of one ubeti (or the reverse).

example.question: Ubeti wa pili wa shairi hili una mishororo mingapi?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child counts all the lines.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: A question about one ubeti with the total as an option.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Count only the lines of that ubeti.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Ubeti ni kundi moja la mishororo. Hesabu mishororo ya ubeti huo tu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Takes a paragraph for a poem, or a poem for a paragraph.

example.question: Ni maandishi yapi ni shairi?
example.wrong_answer: Aya moja ndefu inayoendelea hadi mwisho wa ukurasa

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child does not look at the shape on the page.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: A poem and a paragraph described by their shape.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: How are the lines laid out?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Shairi lina mishororo mifupi iliyopangwa katika beti. Kifungu cha kawaida kina aya ndefu.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.error: Uses i- with one noun of U-I.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.cause: The child has fixed i- as the prefix of U-I.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.feedback: Nomino za U-I hutumia u- kwa umoja: mti umeanguka. Hutumia i- kwa wingi: miti imeanguka.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.error: Uses u- with many nouns of U-I.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.cause: The child does not look at the number.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.reveals: Plural nouns that begin with mi-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.help: Mi- tells you it is many.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.feedback: Wingi wa mti ni miti, na kiambishi ni i-: miti imeanguka.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.error: Gives a noun of U-I the prefix of people (mti anaanguka).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.cause: The child sees m- and thinks of mtoto and mwalimu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.reveals: U-I nouns that begin with m- like people nouns.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.help: Is it a person? A tree and a door are things.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.feedback: Mti na mlango ni vitu, si watu. Vinatumia u- na i-, si a- na wa-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.error: Puts a noun of another class in U-I.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-I?

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.cause: The child sees m- and takes any noun that begins with it.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.M4_UI.reveals: Nouns that begin with m- from different classes.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A play line and a story line side by side.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Takes the words in brackets for words that are said.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child reads everything on the page as speech.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A stage direction among spoken lines.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: What does the actor do, and what does he say?
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Maelekezo ya jukwaani yako kwenye mabano. Yanamwonyesha muigizaji afanye nini, si aseme nini.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Names the wrong speaker of a line.

example.question: Nani alisema, "Nipe kilo mbili za unga"?

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child goes by the name closest to the line.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A line next to the name of another speaker.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: The name before the colon is the speaker.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mhusika anayesema mstari huo.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from the play.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child gives a likely answer and does not look in the play.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A likely answer that the play does not give.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Point to the line in the play that says it.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Jibu la swali la igizo liko ndani ya igizo. Tafuta mstari unaolisema.
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Leaves the verb in its base form where someone is helped (anaandika for anamwandikia).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The child does not see that the verb has to show for whom.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: A sentence with a person who benefits.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Is it done for someone? Then the verb ends in -ia or -ea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kauli ya kutendea huonyesha kitendo kinafanyiwa mtu: anawaandikia, anampikia, anamsomea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Leaves the verb active where the thing is done to (barua imeandika na mwalimu).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The child does not see that the thing, not the person, is the subject.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: A sentence that begins with the thing that was done.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Does the thing do it, or is it done to the thing? Then -wa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kauli ya kutendwa huonyesha kitu kimefanyiwa kitendo: barua imeandikwa, chai imepikwa.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Mixes -ia (for someone) and -wa (done to the thing).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The endings look alike and the child does not ask what the verb says.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: Sentences that need -wa or -ia in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Ask: for someone, or done to the thing?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kutendea (-ia, -ea) ni "kwa ajili ya mtu". Kutendwa (-wa) ni "kinatendwa na mtu".
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Takes a formal setting for an informal one.

example.question: Ni mazungumzo yapi si rasmi?
example.wrong_answer: hotuba ya mwalimu mkuu kwenye gwaride

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child does not ask who is talking to whom.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: A speech or an interview among settings with a friend.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Who is speaking to whom, and where?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki, nyumbani au wakati wa kucheza. Hotuba na mahojiano ni rasmi.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.error: Uses words of the wrong kind of setting (a speech greeting to a friend at play).
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.cause: The child has one way of speaking for every place.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.reveals: A formal greeting for a friend.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.help: Would you say it to a friend at play?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.feedback: Kwa rafiki tunatumia lugha ya kawaida, kama "Mambo vipi?". Hotuba hutumia lugha rasmi.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Picks a related word, not the opposite (usiku-jioni, rafiki-ndugu).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: The child picks a word of the same family of ideas.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.reveals: A related word as an option.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.help: Is it the opposite, or only near it?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: Kinyume ni neno lenye maana kinyume kabisa: usiku-mchana. "Jioni" iko karibu na usiku lakini si kinyume.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Picks a word of the same meaning (furaha-raha).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: The child mixes the opposite with the synonym.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: "Raha" ina maana sawa na furaha. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.error: Gives the other word of a pair in the wrong place (mgeni-rafiki for mgeni-mwenyeji).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.cause: The child takes a word that goes with the idea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.reveals: A word that goes with the noun but is not its opposite.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.help: Who is the visitor and who receives him?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.feedback: Mgeni ni anayetembelea, na mwenyeji ni anayepokea. Ni vinyume.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Gives the wrong animal or thing in the simile (mrefu kama sungura).

example.question: Mtu mrefu sana ni mrefu kama ___.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child knows the idea but not the usual comparison.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: A simile with plausible animals as options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: Which animal do we say is tall?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Tashbihi hutumia ulinganisho wa kawaida: mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama kiboko, mkubwa kama ndovu.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Leaves out kama, and says "Yeye ni twiga" as a simile.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child mixes a simile with a metaphor.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: A simile and a metaphor as options.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: A simile has the word kama.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia kama: mrefu kama twiga. "Yeye ni twiga" ni sitiari.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.error: Takes the simile word for word (the person is really a giraffe).

example.question: "Baba ni mrefu kama twiga" maana yake nini?

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.cause: The child does not read the comparison as a way to describe.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.reveals: A meaning question for a simile.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.help: What is the animal used to show?
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.feedback: Tashbihi inaelezea kwa kulinganisha. "Mrefu kama twiga" ina maana mtu ni mrefu sana.
KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M4_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.error: Uses -na- for every time, whatever the time word.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child has fixed -na- as the way to make a verb.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Read the time word first: jana, now, or kesho?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.feedback: Wakati uliopita unatumia -li-: jana alisoma. Uliopo -na-: sasa anasoma. Ujao -ta-: kesho atasoma.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child knows the markers but not which time each is for.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.reveals: Past and future time words in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Has it happened, or will it happen?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.feedback: -li- ni kwa yaliyotokea. -ta- ni kwa yatakayotokea.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.error: Keeps the tense right and changes the person prefix (wanasoma for tunasoma).

example.question: Chagua kitenzi: Jana sisi ___ kwa basi.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.cause: The child looks at the tense and not at the person.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.reveals: The same verb with different persons.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.help: Who is it? Sisi is tu-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.feedback: Kitenzi kinahitaji nafsi na wakati: sisi tulisafiri, wao walisafiri, mimi nilisafiri.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Only adds ha- or si- and keeps the tense marker (hanasoma, sinasoma).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child does not know that the marker changes in the negative.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative made by only adding ha- or si-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: In the present negative, -na- goes and the verb ends in -i.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Kukanusha wakati uliopo: -na- huondolewa na kitenzi huishia -i: nasoma-sisomi, anasoma-hasomi.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Keeps -li- or -ta- after ha- (halipika, hatapika for hakupika).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child puts ha- in front and leaves the rest.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A past verb with ha- put in front.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Wakati uliopita ukikanushwa, -li- hubadilika kuwa -ku-: alipika-hakupika.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Gives the negative of another time (hasomi for hakusoma).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child negates the verb but does not keep the time.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: Negatives of the three times side by side.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Which time was the first sentence in?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Ukanushaji huhifadhi wakati: uliopita hawakuimba, uliopo hawaimbi, ujao hawataimba.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Takes a positive verb for a negative one.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child does not look for the ha-, si-, hu- or ku-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative and a positive verb together.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Which verb says that it did not, does not or will not happen?
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Neno lililokanushwa linaonyesha kwamba kitendo hakifanyiki: hasomi, hakusoma, hatasoma.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Gives the small form (ki-) for the big form (kijiti for jiti).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child mixes ji- (big) and ki- (small).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: Big is ji-. Small is ki-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Ukubwa wa nomino hutumia ji-: jiti, jito, jiji. Udogo hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Keeps the noun as it is (mti mkubwa for jiti).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child uses the adjective mkubwa and does not change the noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.reveals: The plain noun as an option.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: Big form: the noun itself changes.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Kuonyesha ukubwa, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mji-jiji.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.error: Gives one noun where there are many (jiti for majiti).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.cause: The child does not change the form for many.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.reveals: Singular and plural big forms in turn.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.help: Count: one or many? Many takes ma-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.feedback: Wingi wa ukubwa hutumia ma-: majiti, majito, majiji, majitu.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Gives the big form (ji-) for the small form (jiji for kijiji).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child mixes ji- (big) and ki- (small).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.help: Small is ki-. Big is ji-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.feedback: Udogo wa nomino hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji. Ukubwa hutumia ji-.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Keeps the noun as it is (mto mdogo for kijito).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child uses the adjective mdogo and does not change the noun.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.reveals: The plain noun as an option.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.help: Small form: the noun itself changes.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.feedback: Kuonyesha udogo, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mto-kijito.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.error: Gives one noun where there are many (kijiti for vijiti).
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.cause: The child does not change the form for many.
KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.reveals: Singular and plural small forms in turn.
